title: Thick and silky feeling
text: Thick and silky feeling. These are very thick.  They are definitely a high thread count, not the deceiving count that others put in their description.  The comfort is ok.  They looks smooth and lay well on the pillow.

product_metadata.title: SUPERIOR 1200 Thread Count 100% Egyptian Cotton, Soft and Breathable, 2-Piece Standard Pillowcase Set Solid, Sage
features: SUBTLE SOFTNESS. Our 100% Egyptian Cotton is specially combed to remove all but the finest and longest fibers, making these 1200 thread count pillowcases the ultimate in luxury

COZY OVERSIZED FIT. This 2 Piece Standard Pillowcase Set Includes: Two Oversized Pillowcases measuring 21" x 32" each. 1200 Thread Count Egyptian Cotton is soft, strong, and if cared for properly, will be long lasting

CLASSIC STYLE. The variety of vibrant colors are available in various sizes, featuring a lustrous sheen from the sateen weave. Complete your bedroom décor with the coordinating Duvet Covers and Sheet Sets for a plush, put together look
EASE OF CARE. These beautiful pillowcases are colorfast and machine washable. For drying, tumble dry low and remove them promptly from dryer. Always follow care label instructions for best results
description: Made from 100% Egyptian Cotton in a 1200 Thread Count Sateen weave, these pillowcases offer a smooth surface with an understated luster, and they pair well with both solid and patterned bedding. Coordinating duvet-and-sham sets, as well as sheet sets, are available to pair with these pillowcases, giving bedrooms a more complete, tailored look. The indulgently soft 1200 thread count 100% Genuine Egyptian Cotton provides simple luxury and lasting durability at an affordable price.
We have been manufacturing fine linens for over 40 years. We are experts in manufacturing high quality textiles and pride ourselves on only producing the finest products.
